result.brief: 提出 LeVJEPA：用无塌缩目标（SIGReg）训练单一视频编码器，去除 EMA/stop-gradient/预测器，实现高效可扩展的视频自监督表征预训练。
result.reason: Introduces LeVJEPA, a collapse-free video self-supervised encoder (SIGReg, no EMA/stop-grad), improving video representation pretraining efficiency and motion-centric accuracy—directly matching video representation learning.
